It enables efficient integration by decomposing the 2D integrand into functions constant along the light ray direction ($\gamma$) and the view ray direction ($\beta$).
This allows the use of a partial sum tree to accumulate terms along $\gamma$ independently, reducing the computational complexity from per-pixel to per-slice processing.
It builds on [Multiple Scattering Approximation via Light Volume Lookup](1188-multiple-scattering-approximation-via-light-volume-lookup.md).
